_doc: The local battleground (backend_server/battle.py). map_id is the game's own map id - the client loads its data by it, so it must be a map the client has. bots stand in for the other players and only walk around, so replication can be seen. spawn is (x, y, z) in metres, tick_rate is server ticks per second, matching_seconds is how long the MATCHING screen waits before the battle starts, match_seconds is the round length.
_doc_spawn_points: Where the player comes in, per map: {"<map id>": [x, y, z]}. For a spawn the client has no table for - the spawn island is in the server's level data. Put a waypoint on the spot in a battle and the cmd window prints the line to paste here. y is only a fallback: the ground height there replaces it once the terrain has streamed in. 700: the spawn island, from the waypoint on the big map (x 11516.8, z -2633.6).
